## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should use the same revision identifier as deployment history so operators can match entries directly.

## Changes

The pull request adds a running deployment status formatter that displays an abbreviated revision and the attempt number. It adds tests for the status prefix and attempt label.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision identifier in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` displays `0123456` while `history` displays `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but `status` uses `revision[:7]` and `history` uses `revision[:12]`. — Operators lose five characters that distinguish revisions sharing the same seven-character prefix. — Fix: Use the 12-character abbreviation from `history` and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to check the full status line.
